name: docs

on:
  # trigger deployment on every push to master branch
  push:
    branches: [master]
  # trigger deployment manually
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          # fetch all commits to get last updated time or other git log info
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v1
        with:
          # choose node.js version to use
          node-version: '24'

      # install dependencies if the cache did not hit
      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.yarn-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: yarn --frozen-lockfile

      # run build script
      - name: Build VuePress site
        run: yarn docs:build

      # please check out the docs of the workflow for more details
      # @see https://github.com/crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v2
        with:
          # deploy to gh-pages branch
          target_branch: gh-pages
          # deploy the default output dir of VuePress
          build_dir: docs/.vuepress/dist
        env:
          # @see https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/authentication-in-a-workflow#about-the-github_token-secret
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
